cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
# The central repo builds the chip library plus its own test bench (main.cpp).
# Projects generated by tools/new/samd-new use the same samd-app.cmake and
# point SAMD21_LIB at this repo, so there is one source of build truth.
project(samd21-lib LANGUAGES CXX C ASM)

set(SAMD21_LIB ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../..)

# The central repo builds the chip library. If a main.cpp is present at the
# repo root it is also built as a firmware app (test bench); otherwise this
# is a pure library build.
if(EXISTS ${SAMD21_LIB}/main.cpp)
    set(APP_SOURCES ${SAMD21_LIB}/main.cpp)
endif()

# Extra project-local libraries - managed by tools/new/samd-add-lib
if(EXISTS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/libs.cmake)
    include(${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/libs.cmake)
endif()

include(${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/samd-app.cmake)
